title: Russia frees Brittney Griner in exchange for Viktor Bout at Abu Dhabi airport
body:
On Thursday, 8 December 2022, Russia released US basketball player Brittney Griner in exchange for Viktor Bout, a former Russian arms dealer jailed in the United States. The exchange took place at Abu Dhabi airport in the United Arab Emirates.

Griner had been arrested in February 2022 at a Moscow airport over cannabis oil cartridges in her luggage. She pleaded guilty, saying she had made an honest mistake, and on 4 August 2022 was sentenced to nine years in a Russian prison for drug possession and smuggling. Bout had been serving a 25-year sentence in the United States.

The UAE and Saudi Arabia said their leaders had led the negotiations. The White House said that only the United States and Russia negotiated and that there was no mediation. The United Arab Emirates provided the location for the exchange. US citizen Paul Whelan, a Marine veteran serving 16 years in Russia on espionage charges that Washington says are false, was not included in the swap. President Joe Biden said the United States would keep pushing for his release.
